declarations.name: AuiMenu

inputs.name: auiMenu
inputs.description: Items: action (with optional submenu items), checkbox, radio, separator, and group. Ids are unique across the whole tree.

inputs.name: menuLabel
inputs.description: Menu aria-label. Default: the menu is labelled by the trigger (aria-labelledby).

inputs.name: placement
inputs.description: Top-level popup placement relative to the trigger. Submenus always use right-start (left-start in RTL).

inputs.name: closeOnSelect
inputs.description: Close after activating a checkbox or radio item. Action items always close the menu.

inputs.name: typeahead
inputs.description: Printable characters move focus to the next item whose label starts with them.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Submenu side, submenu arrow keys, and chevron mirroring.

inputs.name: renderItem
inputs.description: Custom item content as a function; or put `<ng-template auiItem let-item>` inside the host (since 0.9.0).

outputs.name: selected
outputs.description: Dispatched on the trigger when the user activates an enabled item. checked is the new state for checkbox and radio items.

outputs.name: opened
outputs.description: Dispatched on the menu element after the top level opened.

outputs.name: closed
outputs.description: Dispatched on the menu element after all levels closed.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open the menu and focus its first (or last) item.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Menu Button and Menu (actions menu) with submenus; roving focus with real DOM focus on items.

limitations: Submenus open on hover after 150 ms without a pointer-safe triangle; moving the pointer diagonally across a sibling item for longer than the delay switches submenus.
Shortcut text is a hint only; the menu does not register the keyboard shortcut or set aria-keyshortcuts.
Radio groups are scoped by group name across the whole menu tree.
There is no menubar (horizontal top-level) mode; use Menu Bar.
